title: Prince Clah royale
description: Replaces Minecraft’s spears and leather armor with those of the Prince from Clash Royale, giving the game a touch inspired by the classic character.
body: This pack transforms the combat experience in Minecraft by replacing the traditional spears with the powerful lances of the Prince from Clash Royale. It also replaces the leather armor with the iconic armor of the same character, giving the player a majestic appearance and an imposing presence on the battlefield. Perfect for those who seek a fusion between the worlds of Minecraft and Clash Royale, adding a touch of style and power to the classic game.
